services_shape: class: a place in a set session (a day camp week or an overnight week) by age group, with a cap for each cabin or group and a free waitlist; each camper is one booking with their own check-in code, checked in at drop-off and handed back only to an approved adult at pick-up. A backyard camp week books two counselors for a group of children at the host family's home. A free camp tour books the director's time.
questions_before_times: each camper's age on the first day of the session, and the grade they finish in June (they set the session and the cabin group)
day camp or overnight, and which week
for an overnight week: girls' or boys' cabins
for a backyard camp: the home's town (the travel area; the street address goes on the secure page), and how many children and their ages
for a camp tour: who is coming, and the child's age
safety_stop: a child hurt, very sick or in danger right now; a child who is missing
a report of abuse or neglect at a camp
first_steps: The camp's agreement and risk notice
The pick-up list and the photo yes or no
Health form, shot record and medicine forms
Backyard camp: each child's forms and the yard check
license: from the state form: a youth camp license or permit for the camp's own grounds where the state's rules require one (a switch), renewed on the state's schedule; health inspections of the grounds, kitchen, water, cabins and swim area where the state's or county's rules require them (a switch); a backyard camp at a family's home may need none, or the host site's own OK (a switch)
staff_skills: head counselor (a cabin group or a day camp group), counselor, camp nurse, waterfront staff, backyard camp counselor, party leader
messages_never: a child's last name, birth date, allergies, medicines, health needs, custody orders, the pick-up list (and who may not pick up) and photos never go in a text; texts to the parent may use the child's first name; texts to Sam or the staff carry none of it: they name the parent and the session, and link to the secure page
